row.question: How do I fix the scheduler crash after upgrading Acme Batch to 4.2?
documents: Acme Batch 4.2 changed the default heap size for the scheduler service. Some installations report that the scheduler crashes during startup after the upgrade. Fix pack 4.2.0.1 resolves this problem. It restores the previous heap default and adds a startup check. The fix pack can be downloaded from the support portal. Release notes for 4.2 list other known issues. The reporting module is unaffected by this change. Customers on version 4.1 do not need to take action. Contact support if the problem persists after applying the fix pack. Logs are written to the scheduler log directory by default.
Acme Batch supports Linux and Windows. Version 4.2 was released in March. Version 4.2 adds a new web console.

row.question: Which ports must be open for the Acme agent?
documents: The Acme agent communicates with the server over two ports. Port 9443 carries encrypted management traffic. Port 9080 is used for health checks. Both ports must be reachable from the server. The agent installer does not modify firewall rules. Administrators must open the ports manually. The agent runs as a background service. Agent logs rotate daily. The agent can be upgraded in place.
